ABOUT ME

Research built around your targeting criteria.

I’m Moudud Karim, a B2B Lead Generation and Prospect List Building Expert working in the field since 2019. I’ve worked with 100+ clients across a wide range of industries and international markets.

My work focuses on identifying relevant companies and decision-makers, building targeted email lists, enriching existing data, and verifying business emails before delivery. I use multiple research sources depending on the project instead of relying on a single database.

    RESEARCH METHODOLOGY

    A practical multi-source workflow

    I choose sources and verification tools according to the targeting criteria and available data.

    01

    Define the Target

    Industry, location, company criteria, decision-maker titles, and required fields.

    02

    Prospect Research

    LinkedIn, Apollo, ZoomInfo, company websites, Google, Yelp, Yellow Pages, and relevant directories.

    03

    Data Enrichment

    Add useful company and contact details from relevant sources where required.

    04

    Email Verification

    Check business emails with NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, MillionVerifier, Verifalia, or MailTester.

    05

    Final QA & Delivery

    Review targeting, formatting, and requested fields before delivering a clean, organized list.

    1. 1

    2. 2
      Business email collected

      The decision-maker's business email is found and added to the lead record, alongside the company, title and LinkedIn details.

    3. 3
      Checked with a verification tool

      The address is run through a dedicated verifier — NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, MillionVerifier, Verifalia or MailTester, depending on the project.

    4. 4
      Result confirmed

      The check comes back clean, so this lead's status flips to ✓ Verified — the same status you can watch in the live list build in the hero above.

    5. 5
      Final QA & delivery

      Targeting and formatting are reviewed one last time, and the verified lead takes its place in the clean, organized spreadsheet you receive.

    FAQ

    Common questions before a project

    Need something more specific? Send your targeting criteria and project requirements.

    What information can you provide?

    Depending on the project, fields can include company name, website, contact name, job title, LinkedIn profile, business email, phone, location, and other requested business information where available.

    Can you work with custom targeting criteria?

    Yes. Research can be based on industry, location, company type, decision-maker title, and other project-specific criteria.

    How do you verify email addresses?

    I use dedicated email verification tools such as NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, MillionVerifier, Verifalia, and MailTester depending on the project.

    Can you enrich my existing database?

    Yes. I can research missing company or contact information and add relevant fields to an existing list.

    What format will I receive?

    Lead data can be organized in a clean spreadsheet structure based on the fields required for your project.

    Can you handle large lead lists?

    Yes. My featured projects include lists of 1,000, 1,700, and 2,000 prospects.

    Can I review a sample first?

    Yes. Send your targeting criteria and I can prepare a small sample so you can review the structure and data quality before discussing a larger project.

    No questions match your searchTry different words — for example “email”, “sample” or “format”.
